title: Psalm 4
opening_line: Give ear unto me when I call,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Give ear unto me when I call,
text.normalized: Give ear unto me when I call,
text.reading: Give ear unto me when I call,

text.diplomatic: God of my righteousness:
text.normalized: God of my righteousness:
text.reading: God of my righteousness:

text.diplomatic: Have mercy, hear my prayer; thou hast
text.normalized: Have mercy, hear my prayer; thou hast
text.reading: Have mercy, hear my prayer; thou hast

text.diplomatic: enlarged me in distress.
text.normalized: Enlarged me in distress.
text.reading: enlarged me in distress.

text.diplomatic: O ye the sons of men! how long
text.normalized: O ye the sons of men! how long
text.reading: O ye the sons of men! how long

text.diplomatic: will ye love vanities?
text.normalized: Will ye love vanities?
text.reading: will ye love vanities?

text.diplomatic: How long my glory turn to shame,
text.normalized: How long my glory turn to shame,
text.reading: How long my glory turn to shame,

text.diplomatic: and will ye follow lies?
text.normalized: And will ye follow lies?
text.reading: and will ye follow lies?

text.diplomatic: But know, that for himself the LORD
text.normalized: But know, that for himself the LORD
text.reading: But know, that for himself the LORD

text.diplomatic: the godly man doth choose:
text.normalized: The godly man doth choose:
text.reading: the godly man doth choose:

text.diplomatic: The LORD, when I on him do call,
text.normalized: The LORD, when I on him do call,
text.reading: The LORD, when I on him do call,

text.diplomatic: to hear will not refuse.
text.normalized: To hear will not refuse.
text.reading: to hear will not refuse.

text.diplomatic: Fear, and sin not; talk with your heart
text.normalized: Fear, and sin not; talk with your heart
text.reading: Fear, and sin not; talk with your heart

text.diplomatic: on bed, and silent be.
text.normalized: On bed, and silent be.
text.reading: on bed, and silent be.

text.diplomatic: Off’rings present of righteousness,
text.normalized: Off’rings present of righteousness,
text.reading: Off’rings present of righteousness,

text.diplomatic: and in the LORD trust ye.
text.normalized: And in the LORD trust ye.
text.reading: and in the LORD trust ye.

text.diplomatic: O who will show us any good?
text.normalized: O who will show us any good?
text.reading: O who will show us any good?

text.diplomatic: is that which many say:
text.normalized: Is that which many say:
text.reading: is that which many say:

text.diplomatic: But of thy countenance the light,
text.normalized: But of thy countenance the light,
text.reading: But of thy countenance the light,

text.diplomatic: LORD, lift on us alway.
text.normalized: LORD, lift on us alway.
text.reading: LORD, lift on us alway.

text.diplomatic: Upon my heart, bestowed by thee,
text.normalized: Upon my heart, bestowed by thee,
text.reading: Upon my heart, bestowed by thee,

text.diplomatic: more gladness I have found
text.normalized: More gladness I have found
text.reading: more gladness I have found

text.diplomatic: Than they, ev’n then, when corn and wine
text.normalized: Than they, ev’n then, when corn and wine
text.reading: Than they, ev’n then, when corn and wine

text.diplomatic: did most with them abound.
text.normalized: Did most with them abound.
text.reading: did most with them abound.

text.diplomatic: I will both lay me down in peace,
text.normalized: I will both lay me down in peace,
text.reading: I will both lay me down in peace,

text.diplomatic: and quiet sleep will take;
text.normalized: And quiet sleep will take;
text.reading: and quiet sleep will take;

text.diplomatic: Because thou only me to dwell
text.normalized: Because thou only me to dwell
text.reading: Because thou only me to dwell

text.diplomatic: in safety, LORD, dost make.
text.normalized: In safety, LORD, dost make.
text.reading: in safety, LORD, dost make.
